sentences.text: Wilhelmina Vivian Slater -LRB- born Wanda Slater -RRB- is a fictional character in the American dramedy series Ugly Betty .	Ugly Betty	Ugly Betty

She is played by Vanessa Williams , who received a supporting actress award at the 2007 and 2008 NAACP Image Awards , a Best TV Villain award at the 2007 Teen Choice Awards and a supporting actress nomination at the 59th , 60th , and 61st Primetime Emmy Awards for her portrayal of the character .	Vanessa Williams	Vanessa Williams	2007 and 2008 NAACP Image Awards	NAACP Image Awards	2007 Teen Choice Awards	Teen Choice Awards	59th	59th Primetime Emmy Awards	60th	60th Primetime Emmy Awards	61st Primetime Emmy Awards	61st Primetime Emmy Awards

Her name is similar to Wilhelmina Cooper , a successful model who eventually established her own modeling company in the 1960s .	Wilhelmina Cooper	Wilhelmina Cooper	her own modeling company	Wilhelmina Models
